description: NaLi₃V₄O₁₂ is Esseneite-like structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic C2 space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.64 Å. There are three inequivalent Li sites. In the first Li site, Li is bonded to six O atoms to form LiO₆ octahedra that share corners with six VO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent LiO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 2.11-2.26 Å. In the second Li site, Li is bonded to six O atoms to form LiO₆ octahedra that share corners with six VO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent LiO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 2.09-2.30 Å. In the third Li site, Li is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 2.07-2.62 Å. There are two inequivalent V sites. In the first V site, V is bonded to four O atoms to form VO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three LiO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent VO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 31-64°. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.67-1.83 Å. In the second V site, V is bonded to four O atoms to form VO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three LiO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent VO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 33-60°. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.67-1.83 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na, one Li, and one V atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to two Li and one V atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Li and two V atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na and two V atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three Li and one V atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to one Na, two Li, and one V atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONaLi₂V tetrahedra.
